subject: New shiny app for business intelligence

messages.author: e1656d208b1207ce
messages.subject: New shiny app for business intelligence
parts: Shiny is a fantastic framework for building interactive and powerful applications. For the past few months I've been working on an app called shinyData to make it easy to perform common data analysis tasks (usually referred to as business intelligence). It's available on GitHub, and it's also hosted at ShinyApps.io. Part of shinyData is essentially a front end to ggplot2 (you can read more about this aspect at my blog post here), but it's intended to be much more than that. In a nutshell, what I envision to achieve is to integrate the features already available in various r packages to create an end-to-end solution to users who may or may not know r. All feedback are welcome.
